details.text: And that's curtains on the Sanju Samson show. Keemo Paul strikes first ball! Short ball on off angled across, and Samson looks to use the pace to pull it behind square. This time he doesn't quite get under it and it goes to Hetmyer in the deep. Hetmyer takes it above head-height before throwing it up in the air as momentum was taking him back. One foot lands behind the ropes, and he steadies himself before casually walking back in and completing the catch. Samson walks back having ensured India a perfect start in this mammoth chase!

One foot lands behind the ropes, and he steadies himself before casually walking back in and completing the catch. Samson walks back having ensured India a perfect start in this mammoth chase!

Keemo Paul strikes back immediately! And that's a bit of a soft dismissal for Ishan Kishan! This is a 140kph slot ball on leg, and Kishan can't quite get under it as he looks to flick it away. Ends up hitting it straight to Jewel Andrew at deep midwicket. Paul leaps and punches the air. Two wickets in the over!

Oh, looked plumb and the finger goes up immediately! But Jewel Andrew has appealed. This is an arm ball on a length outside off, Andrew looks to reverse-sweep but misses the ball and is hit on his right pad around the knee-roll. No bat, and ball-tracking shows the ball crashing into leg stump. Axar gets the breakthrough two balls into his spell and Jewel Andrew's cameo at the top has come to an end

28010.text: Full around off, Iyer is a bit cramped for room as he swings it wide of long-off for a couple
28010.postText: Prudhvi: "That 2022 score card just brought out PTSD from when SRH couldnt hold a bat properly"

27060.text: Paul looks to keep it wide, this time it's fuller, Iyer swings it down to long-on along the ground. This one came off the bottom half of the bat
27060.postText: What unique record did Marnus Labuschagne achieve in the Durban Test. That and five other questions are waiting for you in today's KNOW YOUR CRICKET.

27050.text: With mid-off in the circle, that's easy pickings for Shreyas Iyer! Slower bouncer but it's too wide and Iyer just flat-bats it over mid-off and picks up another boundary

27040.text: Full and wide and Abhishek launches it down the ground. Goes off the toe end and to long-off's right on the bounce

27030.preText: Nitesh: "This must be Abhishek Sharma's lowest not out score in T20 Powerplay. Can you confirm ?" Second lowest in a T20 powerplay where he opened the batting, where we have BBB data. He made 3 off 15 vs RR in IPL 2022.
27030.text: Abhishek will take those deliveries! Length ball going down leg and Abhishek just glances it fine on the leg side

27020.text: Full ball outside off, Iyer looks to swing it away but only manages an inside edge onto his pads. They steal a run as the ball goes to Hope's right

27010.text: Paul starts the over with a bumper outside off, Iyer ducks and sways back, and then enquires for a wide to the square-leg umpire. Nothing doing, the umpire says

26060.text: Length ball spins in from outside off, Iyer pushes it down towards long-on. He wanted two, but the fielder is quick to race in

26050.text: On a length around leg, Abhishek rocks back and pulls it out to deep midwicket on the bounce

26040.text: Length ball outside off spins in, Iyer tucks it out to deep midwicket

26030.text: On a length around middle, Abhishek punches it out through point

26020.text: On a length around middle, clipped back to the bowler
26020.shortText: Chase to Abhishek Sharma, no run

26010.text: Looks to flick and misses. Goes off the pads to the off side
26010.shortText: Chase to Abhishek Sharma, no run

25060.text: Iyer ends the powerplay with a boundary. This is a slower ball on a length outside off and Iyer crunches it through the covers. India get to 80 at the end of the powerplay, one run more than West Indies at this stage
25060.postText: Springer had said there's nothing much to do but be defensive against Abhishek. Looks like he's come up with a plan

25050.text: Springer again follows Abhishek as he backs away leg side. This time it's into the legs and Abhishek misses as he tries to flick it away. Goes to the off side off Abhishek's pads
25050.shortText: Springer to Abhishek Sharma, 1 leg bye

25040.text: Oh, Abhishek manages to get in on the act! Not the most convincing of Abhishek Sharma shots, but he'll take the runs. This is very full on leg, but Abhishek backs away a long way and lofts it up inside out. Manages to clear the cover fielder running back and even with three fielders converging on the ball, they can't prevent the boundary

25030.text: 133kph bouncer on leg, Abhishek ducks and looks to pull but is beaten
25030.shortText: Springer to Abhishek Sharma, no run

25020.text: Length ball on the pads, clips it to midwicket's right for a quick single
